title: The curtain is very sheer, but the quality could be better
text: The curtain is very sheer, but the quality could be better. The quality is not dirt cheap, but it could be better for how much I paid for it. The curtain is extremely sheer and the sizing was perfect for what I needed. Overall, I would return because the quality isn't that great.

product_metadata.title: HLC.ME Antique Taupe Sheer Voile Window Treatment Rod Pocket Curtain Panels for Bedroom, Kitchen, and Living Room (54 x 72 inches Long, Set of 2)
features: Sheer Voile window treatments look great in any style of home, be it traditional or modern farmhouse, offering a lightweight, airy feeling that softens the ambience of a room.

Add a pop of solid color in between embroidered curtains for your living room, or use them alone for a touch of elegant simplicity. You'll love the way these lightweight, billowy panels look blowing in a gentle summer breeze.
Size: Each panel measures 54" inch Wide x 72" inch Long. (Total of two (2) panels - 108" inch Wide x 72" inch Long)
Care Instructions: Machine wash cold, Gentle Cycle. Use only non-chlorine. Bleach as needed. Tumble Dry Low. Iron on lowest setting as needed.
Rod Pocket insert can fit up to 1.5" inch rod.

details.Product Care Instructions: Curtains got a little dusty? Don't fret! Simply toss the curtains in the wash on a cold cycle. Then tumble dry them in the dryer so that they are smooth to the touch. But be sure that you do not bleach them so that they maintain their beauty.
